reason: Parent requested a same-size replication control before any external scores were observed, to distinguish scale augmentation from sample-count regularization and bootstrap effects.
additional_control: Original features replicated three times, scales [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], unit sample weights, identical model types, hyperparameters, random seed and external split.
new_gate: Augmented external stage3 score must be strictly greater than both the original nonaugmented baseline and the threefold identical-replication control before any public OOF diagnostic runs.
interrupted_initial_run: Stopped during augmented external RandomForest fitting, before external score output, gate file, or public OOF. Only baseline checkpoint and configuration/source artifacts existed at interruption.
rerun_policy: Refit all three arms with same split and seed. Preserve original configuration and this amendment; do not search scales. Public OOF, if allowed, compares all three arms; replication is only a confound control.
